launch_server.name: launch_server
launch_server.docstring:
Launch Arize Phoenix locally.
    Uses PHOENIX_PORT from .env (default 6006).

query_phoenix.name: query_phoenix
query_phoenix.docstring: Query Phoenix GraphQL and return the raw JSON payload.

get_last_failure.name: get_last_failure
get_last_failure.docstring:
Scans recent traces in Phoenix. Prioritizes ERROR spans,
    but falls back to recent OK spans if no errors are found.

get_pipeline_map.name: get_pipeline_map
get_pipeline_map.docstring:
Returns the complete discovered pipeline map for the project.
    Shows all components, their relationships, crash history,
    and components found in code that have never been observed running.
    Useful for understanding project structure without reading any code.

route_query.name: route_query
route_query.docstring: Routes incoming query to the appropriate handler.

retrieve_documents.name: retrieve_documents
retrieve_documents.docstring: Retrieves relevant documents from vector store.

lookup_knowledge_graph.name: lookup_knowledge_graph
lookup_knowledge_graph.docstring: Looks up entity relationships in Neo4j knowledge graph.

generate_response.name: generate_response
generate_response.docstring: Generates final response using LLM with retrieved context.

test_auto_instrumentation.name: test_auto_instrumentation
test_auto_instrumentation.docstring: Verify all pipeline functions are traced without any decorators.

test_import_mapper_builds_graph.name: test_import_mapper_builds_graph
test_import_mapper_builds_graph.docstring:
Build import graph from vibe-debug project itself.
    Verify it correctly maps known import relationships.

test_import_mapper_detects_dependencies.name: test_import_mapper_detects_dependencies
test_import_mapper_detects_dependencies.docstring:
Create a fake project where A imports B imports C.
    Verify the graph correctly maps: C is upstream of A,
    A is downstream of C.

test_crash_impact_identifies_affected_mo.name: test_crash_impact_identifies_affected_modules
test_crash_impact_identifies_affected_mo.docstring:
Verify get_crash_impact() correctly identifies which modules
    are affected when a given module crashes.

test_decorator_success.name: test_decorator_success
test_decorator_success.docstring: Ensure decorator returns correct result and captures execution.

test_decorator_silent_failure.name: test_decorator_silent_failure
test_decorator_silent_failure.docstring: Ensure decorator flags silent failure (empty list) as ERROR.

test_interceptor_patches_available_libra.name: test_interceptor_patches_available_libraries
test_interceptor_patches_available_libra.docstring:
IOInterceptor.start() must successfully patch
    at least one HTTP library and the socket layer.
    Returns dict of results - none should raise exceptions.

test_interceptor_captures_http_call_as_s.name: test_interceptor_captures_http_call_as_span
test_interceptor_captures_http_call_as_s.docstring:
Make a real HTTP call while interceptor is active.
    Verify a span appears in Phoenix with correct attributes.

test_interceptor_skips_phoenix_calls.name: test_interceptor_skips_phoenix_calls
test_interceptor_skips_phoenix_calls.docstring:
Interceptor must never create spans for Phoenix OTLP calls.
    This prevents infinite loops where tracing the tracer
    creates more spans which need more tracing.

test_partial_trace_records_crash_and_mar.name: test_partial_trace_records_crash_and_marks_downstream
test_partial_trace_records_crash_and_mar.docstring:
Simulate a pipeline crash at step 3.
    Verify steps 1-2 are COMPLETED, step 3 is FAILED,
    and steps 4-6 are NEVER_REACHED - all from static map.

test_complete_trace_has_no_crash_point.name: test_complete_trace_has_no_crash_point
test_complete_trace_has_no_crash_point.docstring: A successful trace must not mark anything as crashed.

test_report_shows_full_picture_from_stat.name: test_report_shows_full_picture_from_static_map
test_report_shows_full_picture_from_stat.docstring:
Report must show all three sections:
    COMPLETED, FAILED, and NEVER_REACHED.

test_pipeline_discovery_initializes_from.name: test_pipeline_discovery_initializes_from_static
test_pipeline_discovery_initializes_from.docstring:
Pipeline map must be fully populated from static analysis
    before any runtime observations - works on broken projects.

test_pipeline_discovery_updates_from_tra.name: test_pipeline_discovery_updates_from_traces
test_pipeline_discovery_updates_from_tra.docstring:
After recording traces, pipeline map must reflect
    runtime observations - call counts, failures, durations.

test_pipeline_map_persists_to_disk.name: test_pipeline_map_persists_to_disk
test_pipeline_map_persists_to_disk.docstring: Pipeline map must survive restarts via disk cache.

test_static_analyzer_scans_project.name: test_static_analyzer_scans_project
test_static_analyzer_scans_project.docstring:
Run static analyzer on the vibe-debug project itself.
    Verify it finds known functions without running any code.

test_static_analyzer_survives_broken_fil.name: test_static_analyzer_survives_broken_files
test_static_analyzer_survives_broken_fil.docstring:
Analyzer must never crash on syntax errors or unreadable files.
    It should skip bad files and continue scanning the rest.

test_config_generation.name: test_config_generation
test_config_generation.docstring: Verify auto-generated vibedebug.toml contains expected sections.

test_relevance_filter_skips_libraries.name: test_relevance_filter_skips_libraries
test_relevance_filter_skips_libraries.docstring:
RelevanceFilter must skip site-packages and stdlib,
    and only pass project files.

test_universal_tracer_captures_project_f.name: test_universal_tracer_captures_project_functions
test_universal_tracer_captures_project_f.docstring:
UniversalRuntimeTracer must automatically capture function calls
    from project files without any manual decoration.

instrument_all_adapters.name: instrument_all_adapters
instrument_all_adapters.docstring: Placeholder adapter hook for future framework integrations.

_should_instrument.name: _should_instrument
_should_instrument.docstring: Return True if this function should be instrumented.

_get_component_type.name: _get_component_type
_get_component_type.docstring: Infer component type from module name for better span labels.

auto_instrument_module.name: auto_instrument_module
auto_instrument_module.docstring:
Import a module and wrap all its public functions with vibetrace.
    Uses wrapt to patch functions without modifying source code.

auto_instrument_all.name: auto_instrument_all
auto_instrument_all.docstring: Instrument all modules listed in vibedebug.toml [watch] section.

vibetrace.name: vibetrace
vibetrace.docstring:
Universal decorator to capture AI pipeline spans.
    Captures: function name, inputs (str), outputs, silent failures (None, [], ""), 
    exceptions, and timing.

start.name: start
start.docstring:
One-line entry point for vibe-debug.
    1. Scans project statically with ast (instant, no execution needed)
    2. Auto-generates vibedebug.toml if not present
    3. Initializes tracer
    4. Auto-instruments watched modules
    5. Activates framework adapters

load_config.name: load_config
load_config.docstring: Load config from vibedebug.toml, return defaults if not found.

generate_config.name: generate_config
generate_config.docstring:
Auto-generate vibedebug.toml from static analysis results.
    Never overwrites user edits - only updates discovered sections.

get_dependents.name: get_dependents
get_dependents.docstring:
Return all modules that import the given module.
        These are the modules that break if module_name breaks.

get_downstream.name: get_downstream
get_downstream.docstring:
Recursively find all modules downstream of module_name.
        These are all modules that directly or indirectly depend on it.

get_upstream.name: get_upstream
get_upstream.docstring:
Recursively find all modules upstream of module_name.
        These are modules module_name depends on.

build_graph.name: build_graph
build_graph.docstring:
Build the full import dependency graph using ast-based
        import extraction (fast, works on broken code too).
        Falls back gracefully on any error.

_file_to_module.name: _file_to_module
_file_to_module.docstring: Convert absolute file path to dotted module name.

_is_project_module.name: _is_project_module
_is_project_module.docstring: Return True if this is a project module not a stdlib/library.

_extract_imports_ast.name: _extract_imports_ast
_extract_imports_ast.docstring: Extract all import names from a file using ast.

get_crash_impact.name: get_crash_impact
get_crash_impact.docstring:
Given a module that crashed, return:
        - directly_affected: modules that import it directly
        - transitively_affected: all downstream modules

to_dict.name: to_dict
to_dict.docstring: Serialize import graph for storage and MCP use.

_patch_requests.name: _patch_requests
_patch_requests.docstring: Patch requests.Session.request() to capture all HTTP calls.

_patch_httpx.name: _patch_httpx
_patch_httpx.docstring: Patch httpx.Client.request() to capture all HTTP calls.

_patch_socket.name: _patch_socket
_patch_socket.docstring:
Patch socket.create_connection() as universal TCP fallback.
        Captures any outbound TCP connection regardless of library.
        Does NOT patch Phoenix's own OTLP connection to avoid loops.

_traced_http_call.name: _traced_http_call
_traced_http_call.docstring:
Shared span creation logic for HTTP calls.
        Used by both requests and httpx patches.

load_static_map.name: load_static_map
load_static_map.docstring:
Load the static pipeline map from the analyzer.
        Used to fill in components that never ran due to crash.

load_import_graph.name: load_import_graph
load_import_graph.docstring:
Load the import dependency graph from ImportMapper.
        Used to accurately identify which components are NEVER_REACHED
        based on real import dependencies - not just everything in
        the static map.

start_trace.name: start_trace
start_trace.docstring: Begin tracking a new query through the pipeline.

record_start.name: record_start
record_start.docstring: Record that a component started executing.

record_success.name: record_success
record_success.docstring: Record that a component completed successfully.

record_failure.name: record_failure
record_failure.docstring:
Record that a component crashed.
        Automatically marks all downstream components as NEVER_REACHED
        using the static map to identify what depended on this component.

_mark_downstream_unreached.name: _mark_downstream_unreached
_mark_downstream_unreached.docstring:
Use import graph when available for accurate downstream detection.
        Falls back to static map if import graph not loaded.

finish_trace.name: finish_trace
finish_trace.docstring:
Close the active trace. If incomplete, run partial assembly
        to fill in any components that static analysis knows about
        but never ran.

get_last_trace_report.name: get_last_trace_report
get_last_trace_report.docstring:
Generate a human-readable report of the most recent trace.
        This is what the MCP bridge will surface to the IDE.

get_crash_prone.name: get_crash_prone
get_crash_prone.docstring: Components that have failed at least once.

get_never_observed.name: get_never_observed
get_never_observed.docstring: Components known from static analysis but never run.

get_critical_path.name: get_critical_path
get_critical_path.docstring: Components that appear in most traces - likely the main pipeline.

initialize.name: initialize
initialize.docstring:
Build initial pipeline map from static analysis and
        import graph - before any runtime observations.

record_trace.name: record_trace
record_trace.docstring:
Update pipeline map with observations from a completed trace.
        Called after every run - successful or crashed.

get_pipeline_report.name: get_pipeline_report
get_pipeline_report.docstring:
Generate a complete human-readable pipeline map.
        This is what get_pipeline_map() MCP tool returns.

_load_cache.name: _load_cache
_load_cache.docstring: Load persisted pipeline map from disk if it exists.

scan.name: scan
scan.docstring:
Full project scan. Returns complete StaticPipelineMap.
        Skips files that fail to parse - never crashes on bad code.

_collect_python_files.name: _collect_python_files
_collect_python_files.docstring: Walk project directory and collect all .py files.

_analyze_file.name: _analyze_file
_analyze_file.docstring:
Parse a single .py file with ast and extract all functions
        and their call relationships. Skips silently on parse error.

_extract_call_name.name: _extract_call_name
_extract_call_name.docstring: Extract a readable name from a Call node.

_detect_entry_points.name: _detect_entry_points
_detect_entry_points.docstring: Identify likely entry point files by name.

_detect_modules.name: _detect_modules
_detect_modules.docstring: Collect unique module names found in the project.

is_relevant.name: is_relevant
is_relevant.docstring:
Return True if this function call should be traced.
        Fast path: check path fragments first, then function names.

_trace_dispatch.name: _trace_dispatch
_trace_dispatch.docstring:
Core sys.settrace() callback.
        Called by Python interpreter on every function event.
        Must be extremely fast - runs on every function call.

_on_call.name: _on_call
_on_call.docstring:
Handle a function call event.
        Creates an OTel span and stores start time in frame locals.

_on_exception.name: _on_exception
_on_exception.docstring: Handle exception in function - mark span as error.
